column4: Close-up of the same porcelain maid doll's head and shoulders, falling: face tipped up toward the top of the frame, wide open eyes, mouth tight, her long orange hair streaming straight upward from the head, flower ornament at the side. One single hairline crack runs down across the porcelain of her left cheek. Same face, hair, flower ornament and porcelain look as the references. The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140) with nothing else in it; clean closed outline, no strings, no text.

Same camera and scale as the reference pose. She hangs upright in mid-air with her knees slightly bent and both feet dangling, arms hanging loosely a little away from her body, head bowed, falling slackly with her hair and skirt lifted a little by the fall. Three-quarter front view. Full-body view of the same porcelain maid doll as in the reference sheet and the approved pose: same face, long orange hair, orange flower ornament with white center, black dress with white apron and ruffles, white boots, ball joints and wrist rings. Exactly two arms, two legs, two feet and five fingers per hand; no strings, no controller, no floor, no shadow. The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140) with nothing else in it; the figure has a clean closed outline against it. The whole figure fits the frame with a small margin.

Looking straight along the shaft, tight close-up of a white porcelain boot toe hanging in mid air, pointing down, just one hand-width above a patch of coal-dark soil at the bottom of the frame. A clear black gap separates the toe from the soil. Behind the soil the shelf edges of the book shaft, as in the first reference. A few thin tan-gold strings pass down from the top edge. No text.

Identical locked camera, workshop, bench, shelves and floor as the first reference. The same small porcelain maid doll (second reference) is being dragged onto the left end of the central bench: she is sitting slumped at its edge with her legs hanging over the front, head down, arms limp. Keep her small, readable and in the same flat three-ink look. No text.

Identical locked overhead camera and workbench as the first reference. The same porcelain maid doll lies on her back at the near center of the bench, seen from above, calm neutral face turned up, arms resting along her sides. Tools stay at the edges. No text.
